text:
Nora: FYI — two onboarding reports that the next-eval-starter fails during the embedding step with a cryptic 'no vector store configured' error on preview deploy.
Diego: hmm that's odd, the README shows the in-memory store fallback. error paste?
Nora: gist: https://gist.github.com/nora/embed-error. main log: 
Nora: ```
Error: VectorStoreError: no vector store configured
    at createEmbeddings (/workspace/samples/next-eval/src/embeddings.js:42:15)
```
Harpreet: I reproduced locally. repro steps: npm i, pnpm dev, open /eval, click Run -> fails. root cause seems to be NEXT_PUBLIC_EMBED_STORE unset in preview and the sample expects process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMBED_STORE ||= 'memory' at runtime, but on edge SSR envs NEXT_PUBLIC_* may be stripped.
Diego: whoa that's subtle. Using NEXT_PUBLIC_ for server-sensitive config is backwards. We intended the fallback to be server-only and not rely on client envs.
Nora: also the eval-harness e2e_embed.py assumes exact vector IDs returned and fails if memory store order differs. made the deploy flakey.
Harpreet: proposed fixes: 1) change env name to EMBED_STORE (server-only) in sample and README; 2) ensure server route sets default if unset (const store = process.env.EMBED_STORE || 'memory'); 3) update eval-harness to validate semantic similarity instead of exact IDs.
Diego: agree. small code diff suggestion for pages/api/embeds.js: 
Diego: ```js
import { createInMemoryStore, createDuckDBStore } from '@redwood/samples-stores';
const STORE = process.env.EMBED_STORE || 'memory';
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const store = STORE === 'duckdb' ? createDuckDBStore() : createInMemoryStore();
  // ...
}
```
Nora: also we need to update the Next starter template to avoid using NEXT_PUBLIC_* for server config; I've seen multiple users leak API keys by mistake. audit would help.
Harpreet: for eval-harness change: instead of asserting exact vector IDs, assert that the retrieved nearest neighbor texts include the expected answer or have cosine > 0.8. that reduces flakiness and mirrors real-world tests.
EvalBot: CI note: samples/eval-harness job #220 failed on test_e2e_embed.py (assertion mismatch).
Diego: I'll open PR that updates sample env names + API route guard + README. PR will also include a small migration note.
Nora: I'll handle eval-harness semantic change — switch to fuzzy_assert and reuse staging preview to avoid full redeploy for each run. ETA: 48h.
Harpreet: long-term: add an onboarding checklist for sample apps: env var hygiene, server/client separation, and eval-harness semantic checks. Could be a templates/ONBOARDING.md in repo.
Diego: good idea. also add a pre-commit lint rule that flags NEXT_PUBLIC_* usage in server-only files. simple grep in lint-staged.
Nora: quick smoke: after local change to EMBED_STORE the preview built and embed flow worked. will attach preview URL to PR.
DevEx Bot: PR #5077 opened: "samples: server-only embed config + eval-harness fuzzy asserts". CI queued.
Nora: thanks team — small change but should reduce a lot of new-user friction. :rocket:
